cocktails.title: Chicken Tacos
steps: Season and cook the chicken until fully done
Shred or slice the chicken into small pieces
Warm the tortillas in a pan
Fill tortillas with chicken, onion, and cilantro

cocktails.title: Beef Burrito
steps: Cook the ground beef with salt and pepper
Add rice, beans, beef, and cheese to each tortilla

cocktails.title: Quesadillas
steps: Heat a pan over medium heat
Place one tortilla and add cheese on top
Cover with another tortilla and cook until golden
Flip, cook the other side, and slice

cocktails.title: Chilaquiles
steps: Heat the salsa in a pan
Add tortilla chips and toss lightly
Top chilaquiles with eggs, cheese, and onion

cocktails.title: Enchiladas
steps: Roll the tortillas and place them in a baking dish
Pour enchilada sauce over the top
Add cheese and bake until hot and melted

cocktails.title: Horchata
steps: Blend the soaked rice with water
Strain the mixture into a pitcher

cocktails.title: Agua de Jamaica
steps: Boil the hibiscus flowers in water
Let the mixture steep for a few minutes

cocktails.title: Mexican Hot Chocolate
steps: Heat the milk in a saucepan
Whisk until fully melted and frothy

cocktails.title: Churros
steps: Bring water and sugar to a boil
Stir in flour to form a dough
Pipe strips of dough into hot oil
Fry until golden and coat with cinnamon sugar

cocktails.title: Flan
steps: Melt sugar into caramel and pour into a mold
Bake in a water bath and chill before serving

cocktails.title: Guacamole
steps: Mash the avocados in a bowl

cocktails.title: Pico de Gallo
steps: Dice the tomatoes, onion, and jalapeño

cocktails.title: Nachos
steps: Spread chips on a baking tray
Add beans and cheese on top

cocktails.title: Carne Asada
steps: Marinate the beef with garlic, lime, salt, and pepper
Grill the steak until desired doneness
Let rest for a few minutes

cocktails.title: Tacos al Pastor
steps: Cook the pork in a pan or grill
Assemble tacos with pork, pineapple, onion, and cilantro

cocktails.title: Birria Tacos
steps: Slow cook beef in chili sauce

cocktails.title: Chicken Flautas
steps: Roll tightly and fry until crispy

cocktails.title: Mexican Party Bites
steps: Top mini tortillas with beans and cheese
